auditRule.visible: share of the target's own pixels the room shows on its slot (the plate's albedo with and without it, under what the room paints in front of the slot)
auditRule.contrast: F4 as written: mean-luminance ratio, visible target vs a 24 su ring, on the composed room
auditRule.edge: median luminance ratio across the visible silhouette's edge (each edge pixel vs the background within 3 su), on the composed room with no other thing that moves
auditRule.clutter: share of busy pixels (Sobel luminance gradient > 40) in the ring 16–120 su around the object's box, on the shipped layers composed at rest: for `targets`, the home layout composed whole (every thing on its first slot); for `placements`, `busy` with nothing else that moves, plus each neighbouring placement's `near` count when it is in the layout (the game's arithmetic)
auditRule.pieces: the room's pieces are composed on the plate's plane at rest; an object kept behind a piece (gate) is measured with that piece open; visibleAtRest / visibleOpen: its visible share with every piece shut / open
auditRule.layout: GAME03-REPLAYABILITY-05: `targets` are the objects in the home layout (every thing on its first slot); `placements` are every pool object on every slot it may take
